old_hint_push.text: A hint, huh. Fine. Every legend needs a little push.

old_hint_smart.text: Asking for help already? Smart. Sad, but smart.

old_hint_stare.text: A hint? In my day we just stared at it until it gave up.

old_hint_tell.text: Go on, take the hint. I won't tell anyone. I'll tell everyone.

old_idle_crossword.text: I started a crossword while I wait. It's going better.

old_idle_glacier.text: I've seen glaciers with more hustle.

old_idle_gossip.text: Still thinking? The squares are starting to gossip.

old_idle_kettle.text: Should I put the kettle on? Feels like a two-kettle puzzle.

old_idle_nap.text: Wake me up when you've got a move. I'll be snoozing.

old_idle_twenty.text: Take your time. I've got maybe twenty years left.

old_idle_younger.text: Any day now. I'm not getting any younger.

old_lose_goldfish.text: Game over. Even my goldfish saw that coming.

old_lose_popcorn.text: And that's the ballgame. Rematch? I'll get my popcorn.

old_lose_sideways.text: Well, that went sideways. Dust yourself off, kiddo.

old_lose_tape.text: Out of hearts. I'd lend you one, but mine runs on duct tape.

old_rescue_cat.text: Rescued! Like a cat from a tree. A very confused cat.

old_rescue_coins.text: Coins well spent. That buddy was a disaster.

old_rescue_modern.text: Buying your way out of trouble? Very modern.

old_rescue_refund.text: Rescue, huh. Nothing says confidence like a refund.

old_undo_dizzy.text: Make up your mind! The board's getting dizzy.

old_undo_hokey.text: Undo, redo, undo. You're doing the hokey pokey.

old_undo_rocking.text: Back and forth, back and forth. Are you solving, or rocking in a chair?

old_undo_vacation.text: That undo button's gonna need a vacation.

old_win_eventually.text: You won. Eventually. I'll allow it.

old_win_gaveup.text: Well, look at that. The board gave up before you did.

old_win_paint.text: That was like watching paint dry. But with a happy ending.

old_win_ugly.text: A win's a win. Even an ugly one.

old_win_yesterday.text: Done already? Oh wait, you started yesterday. Nice.

old_wrong_again.text: Ha! Classic. Do it again, I missed it.

old_wrong_chaos.text: Oh sure, put it there. Why not. Chaos is free.

old_wrong_choice.text: That's a choice. Not a good one, but a choice.

old_wrong_close.text: Close. Well, no. Not close at all, actually.

old_wrong_knees.text: My knees make better decisions than that. And they're sixty years old.

old_wrong_loudly.text: I'm not saying it's wrong. The board is saying it's wrong. Loudly.

old_wrong_love.text: Nope. And I say that with all the love I have left.

old_wrong_money.text: You tapped that like it owed you money.

old_wrong_nickel.text: In my day a wrong move cost you a nickel. You'd be broke by now.

old_wrong_personal.text: Did the board do something to you? That felt personal.

old_wrong_pigeon.text: Even a pigeon would've skipped that square. A pigeon!

old_wrong_stick.text: Back in my day we solved these with a stick. And we were faster.

old_wrong_tea.text: Wrong. I'd explain why, but my tea's getting cold.

old_wrong_teacher.text: Somewhere, a puzzle teacher just felt a chill.

roman_almost.text: Roman says: so close… and yet so Roman.

roman_badge_fridge.text: Roman says: badge unlocked. Put it on the fridge!

roman_badge_impressed.text: Roman says: badge get! Roman is impressed.

roman_badge_shiny.text: Roman says: new badge! So shiny!

roman_badge_wear.text: Roman says: ooh, a badge. Can I wear it?

roman_banana.text: Roman says: banana split victory. You did it!

roman_bonk.text: Roman says: bonk. Try a different square.

roman_booger.text: Roman says: booger face, champion heart!

roman_boss.text: Roman says: I am the puzzle boss.

roman_brain.text: Roman's brain: big. Your move: bigger.

roman_brainfart.text: Roman says: tiny brain fart. You're fine.

roman_broccoli.text: Roman says: broccoli power. You cleared that board!

roman_bubblegum.text: Roman says: bubblegum pop. Sticky sweet win!

roman_cantwin.text: Roman says: well, you can't win them all.

roman_cheer.text: Roman says: yes! Keep that energy!

roman_cheese.text: Roman says: extra cheese on that win. Delicious!

roman_close.text: Personal space! Even buddies need it.

roman_clutch.text: Roman says: clutch! That was clean!

roman_cocky.text: Roman says: don't get cocky. I'm still watching.

roman_colorblind.text: Roman says: are you color blind? That color's taken!

roman_cook.text: Roman says: you cooked that board!

roman_critter.text: Roman says: you caught the spark critter!

roman_cuddle.text: Roman says: no cuddling — even corners count!

roman_dance.text: Roman says: I'm doing a tiny victory dance with my eyebrows.

roman_dino.text: Roman says: I was thinking about dinosaurs the whole time.

roman_eyeballs.text: Roman says: I beat that with my eyeballs closed. Mostly.

roman_forgot.text: Roman says: wait — what were we talking about?

roman_fridge.text: Roman says: I was talking to the fridge. It gets me.

roman_ghost.text: Roman says: boo! Just kidding. You won!

roman_hearts.text: Roman says: hearts down, spirit up. Rematch!

roman_helicopter.text: Roman says: helicopter hair. We are taking off!

roman_highfive.text: Roman says: high five, puzzle champ!

roman_highfiveself.text: Roman says: high five to myself. You can watch.

roman_highhopes.text: Roman says: I had high hopes for you. Bummer.

roman_hint_clue.text: Roman says: tiny clue. Big brain.

roman_hint_psst.text: Roman says: psst. Look over there.

roman_hint_secret.text: Roman says: I didn't tell you this, but try that square.

roman_idle_admire.text: Roman says: I am admiring this empty square.

roman_idle_blink.text: Roman says: blink twice if you are still there.

roman_idle_hello.text: Roman says: hello? The board is getting lonely.

roman_idle_loading.text: Roman says: still loading your next move.

roman_idle_sandwich.text: Roman says: I could eat a sandwich while I wait.

roman_idle_snore.text: Roman says: zzz. Wake me when you tap.

roman_idle_sphinx.text: Roman says: the sphinx is less patient than me.

roman_itchy.text: Roman says: my butt is itchy. Anyway — you won!

roman_juice.text: Roman says: victory! Also — juice box, please.

roman_lizard.text: Roman says: a tiny lizard just clapped for you!

roman_lose_fought.text: Roman says: that board fought back. Rematch?

roman_lose_nap.text: Roman says: out of hearts. Even legends need a nap.

roman_lose_round.text: Roman says: the board wins this round. Not the war.

roman_lose_snacks.text: Roman says: hearts empty, snack bowl full. Try again!

roman_moonwalk.text: Roman says: moonwalk across the board. Smooth!

roman_myboard.text: Roman says: nice try. Still my board though.

roman_nap.text: Roman says: nap time. You earned it. I earned it more.

roman_nope.text: Roman says: nope-a-dope. Not that one.

roman_nudge.text: Roman says: trust the empty square.

roman_nugget.text: Roman says: this win smells like chicken nuggets.

roman_okayfine.text: Roman says: okay fine. That one was pretty good.

roman_oops.text: Whoops! That was a spicy miss.

roman_pants.text: Roman says: I put on my fancy pants for this win!

roman_pickle.text: Roman says: pickle me proud. That was crisp!

roman_plotwin.text: Roman says: plot twist — you actually did it!

roman_potato.text: Roman says: potato. That's the whole comment.

roman_practice.text: Roman says: practice more — then challenge me.

roman_proud.text: Roman says: I'm proud of that move!

roman_raccoon.text: Roman says: a raccoon stole my strategy. Still won vibes.

roman_retry.text: Roman says: plot twist — try again!

roman_rowmate.text: Roman says: that row already has a roommate!

roman_samecolor.text: Roman says: same color club is full!

roman_sandwich.text: Roman says: did anyone see where I left my sandwich?

roman_shoe.text: Roman says: hang on — I lost a shoe under the couch.

roman_shrug.text: Roman says: shrug. Magic. Next board.

roman_silly.text: Roman says: silly goose move. Shake it off!

roman_skillissue.text: Roman says: skill issue. Shake it off!

roman_sleeping.text: Roman says: did you fall asleep mid-tap?

roman_sneeze.text: Roman says: achoo! You still won though.

roman_sock.text: Roman says: who took my other sock?

roman_spaghetti.text: Roman says: there's spaghetti on the ceiling. Not sorry.

roman_spin_lucky.text: Roman says: lucky spin! Roman approves.

roman_spin_ooh.text: Roman says: ooh! What did you get?

roman_spin_spoken.text: Roman says: the wheel has spoken!

roman_stash.text: Roman says: critter stash complete! Big bonus!

roman_stash_jazz.text: Roman says: critter stash! Roman is doing jazz hands.

roman_stash_party.text: Roman says: five sparks! Sparkle party!

roman_stillbetter.text: Roman says: you did great — but I'm still better.

roman_taco.text: Roman says: cool cool. Now where are the tacos?

roman_toes.text: Roman says: my toes are freezing. Celebrate harder.

roman_trumpet.text: Roman says: toot toot! Victory trumpet!

roman_trying.text: Roman says: are you even trying?

roman_underpants.text: Roman says: superhero underpants. Cape not included!

roman_unicorn.text: Roman says: unicorn sparkles. That move was magic!

roman_victoryburp.text: Roman says: quiet victory burp. Excuse Roman.

roman_warmup.text: Roman says: that was your warm-up, right?

roman_win.text: Roman wins! Confetti in my hair!

roman_worm.text: Roman says: even the worm is doing a happy wiggle!

roman_wrong_bold.text: Roman says: bold move. Wrong square.

roman_wrong_complaint.text: Roman says: I filed a tiny complaint about that tap.

roman_wrong_drama.text: Roman says: the drama. The miss. The heart.

roman_wrong_grandma.text: Roman says: even my grandma would skip that square.

roman_wrong_oof.text: Roman says: oof. That one bounced off.

roman_wrong_politely.text: Roman says: politely, that spot is a no.

roman_wrong_trophy.text: Roman says: no trophy for that square.

roman_wrong_wifi.text: Roman says: that move has no signal.

spark_1.text: One sparkle so far. Four more for the bonus!

spark_2.text: Two sparkles. Three more for the bonus!

spark_3.text: Three sparkles. Two more for the bonus!

spark_4.text: Four sparkles. Just one more for the bonus!

spark_have_1.text: You've got one sparkle toward the bonus.

spark_have_2.text: You've got two sparkles toward the bonus.

spark_have_3.text: You've got three sparkles toward the bonus.

spark_have_4.text: You've got four sparkles. So close!
